verdict.rationale: Name.com documents bulk domain search/check (up to 50 domains) and community confirms a UI bulk nameserver-change feature for up to 50 domains at once; API endpoints exist for registration, transfer, DNS/nameserver updates, and renewals guidance. However, there is no documented bulk/batch API endpoint for registration, renewal, or transfer (each API call appears single-domain), so power-user bulk workflows beyond search/NS-change rely on looping individual API calls or the web UI. Missing for 10: explicit bulk registration API, bulk renewal API, bulk transfer API, and independent verification of bulk operations at scale via API.
